question: According to the notes, how should evidence coverage be treated relative to answer fluency in research synthesis evaluation?
required_claim: Fluent answers can still omit required evidence; coverage must be scored separately.

passages.text: A photography club posted an exhibition in the student center hallway.
The HVAC filter replacement schedule was updated for March.
Eval note L: A synthesis can read fluently and still miss several required findings, so answer correctness alone is an incomplete metric.
A chess tournament bracket was printed on the dorm notice board.
Eval note M: Evidence coverage should be measured as the fraction of gold evidence items actually used or correctly cited, separately from fluency.
The music practice rooms introduced online booking slots.
A campus map kiosk was moved closer to the main gate.
